response: Subtract 1 from both sides: (x+1)/(x−2) − 1 > 0, so (x+1 − (x−2))/(x−2) > 0, which gives 3/(x−2) > 0. The numerator 3 is always positive, so we need x − 2 > 0, i.e., x > 2.
